Setting: near-term ramp of the published plan's addressable shares (replaces the addressable_ramp_years ramp, and scales the growth cap, in each listed year 2026-2030); null = the default ramp.

Setting: first year of the advance credit.

Setting: the advance as a fraction of the sizing scenario's recoverable savings, PV at the financing rate (advance_sizing_basis 'recoverable', default 0.5), or of the NPV at 3% of its customer savings ('customer_savings' basis, the earlier sizing).
Setting: the scenario whose customer-savings NPV sizes the advance. Default Cautious.
Setting: years over which the level credit is paid (the model's choice; not specified in the request).

Setting: securitized (default) = the balance accrues at advance_securitized_rate (4%), interest paid to bondholders; utility_regulatory_asset = it accrues at the utility's after-tax WACC and that return is the utility's, reported separately from shared savings earnings.
Setting: financing rate when the advance is securitized.
Setting: recoveries are limited so that customers' net saving in any year (all customers, system level) is never negative: no year's shared-savings bill exceeds BAU because of the advance.

Setting: bill_savings (default) = recovered through a rider that withholds a share of each year's total customer saving compared with BAU (efficiency energy and value streams included, after shared savings earnings); pool = recovered from the positive savings pool before sharing (the earlier behaviour, which also reduces shared savings earnings).

Setting: recoverable (default) = size the advance on the sizing scenario's recoverable savings (the recovery base: positive customer saving for bill_savings, positive pool for pool), PV at the financing rate; customer_savings = NPV at 3% of the sizing scenario's customer savings (the earlier sizing, which the pool cannot repay).

Setting: how the customers' share of the shared savings pool is split between residential and non-residential customers. Costs follow the benefits they buy; only savings are reallocated: the network (distribution) revenue-requirement reduction net of shared savings earnings, in years it is positive, goes to residential customers at the option's share. Program costs (flexible and efficiency spend, including capitalised amortisation and return), supply, capacity, transmission, losses and efficiency energy savings, and any year's negative network remainder, stay allocated by sales. 'by_sales' (default, the earlier method): residential share of sales (residential_sales_share, EIA-861). 'per_customer': equal per customer, by the class customer counts below. 'custom': custom_residential_share. The setting drives the engine's residential bill (an allocation adjustment line in the delivery rider category), headlines and the dividend advance's bill cap (METHODOLOGY 3.10b).
Setting: residential share of the pool's customer share under customer_allocation 'custom' (export allocation_sweep uses 0.5).
